items.title: Four equivalent conditions for a morphism from the spectrum of a field to be of finite type
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma collects four equivalent conditions on a morphism from the spectrum of a field to a scheme: being of finite type, being locally of finite type, being given by a finite ring map on some affine chart, and having closed image with finite residue field extension (statement lines 3043-3057). The counted proof is short but not a citation: it uses quasi-compactness of the singleton source for the first equivalence, the algebra lemma on finite type domain extensions inside a field to produce the localizing element that makes the field a finite module, and the field-theoretic behaviour of finite ring maps to close the remaining implications (proof lines 3059-3086). It is H2: each implication is carried out in the counted span and the cited inputs are elementary algebra.
